Setup instructions

Follow the practical guide

Original installation instructions

  1. Codex CLI route: Review installer hooks and telemetry settings; run npx impeccable install --providers=codex --scope=project from the project.
  2. Reload and invoke $impeccable init. Request a critique before a focused polish pass. Expect actionable findings, not accessibility certification.
Check before keeping it

Ask for one small result, inspect the output and permissions, and confirm it suits your app. If it fails, undo your changes and return to your original project.
